scripts.text:
[Dyer Ginedin Rephere]
11... 12... Mmm... good. I think I'll be able to finish before tonight's party. Oh! I didn't notice you were here!
scripts.translation:
[染色师 吉内丁·雷菲尔]
11... 12... 嗯...不错。我想今晚的派对前就能完工。哦！我没注意到你在这里！

scripts.text:
[Dyer Ginedin Rephere]
How may I assist you?
scripts.translation:
[染色师 吉内丁·雷菲尔]
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: - Talk
scripts.translation: - 交谈

scripts.text: - Dye Clothing
scripts.translation: - 服装染色

scripts.text: - Price List
scripts.translation: - 价格表

scripts.text:
[Dyer Ginedin Rephere]
Life may have gotten a bit better, but when I look at all of the orders I've received... Whew!
It seems that the young women of Rune-Midgarts must be very well off these days.
scripts.translation:
[染色师 吉内丁·雷菲尔]
生活或许好过了一些，但看看我收到的这些订单...呼！看来卢恩·米德加兹的年轻女性最近都很富裕啊。

scripts.text:
[Dyer Ginedin Rephere]
Not that I think that they are indulging in anything luxurious, mind you.
I don't think there is anything wrong with the pursuit of beauty and being fashionable.
scripts.translation:
[染色师 吉内丁·雷菲尔]
我可不是说她们在追求奢侈享受。追求美丽与时尚，我觉得并没有什么不对。

scripts.text:
[Dyer Ginedin Rephere]
For us humans, who have no colorful fur or decorative scales, clothes are one of the few ways we have to display our personality, style, and beauty.
scripts.translation:
[染色师 吉内丁·雷菲尔]
人类没有艳丽的皮毛，也没有装饰性的鳞片，衣服是我们少数能展现个性、风格与美丽的方式之一。

scripts.text:
[Dyer Ginedin Rephere]
Oh... you need my work? Well... okay, sounds good.
scripts.translation:
[染色师 吉内丁·雷菲尔]
哦...你需要我帮忙吗？嗯...好啊，没问题。

scripts.text:
[Dyer Ginedin Rephere]
Please choose a color
that suits you.
scripts.translation:
[染色师 吉内丁·雷菲尔]
请选择适合你的颜色。

scripts.text:
[Dyer Ginedin Rephere]
I can change your dye to
the default for free.
Are you sure?
scripts.translation:
[染色师 吉内丁·雷菲尔]
我可以免费帮你恢复默认颜色。
确定吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.translation:

给衣服染色需要相应的染料，详情请查看我的价目表。

Your clothes have been dyed {0}.
scripts.translation:
[染色师 吉内丁·雷菲尔]
你的衣服已染成{0}。

scripts.text:
[Dyer Ginedin Rephere]
I can change your dye to
the default for free.
Are you sure?
scripts.translation:
[染色师 吉内丁·雷菲尔]
我可以免费帮你恢复默认颜色。
确定吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Dyer Ginedin Rephere]
For me to dye your clothes, I'll need the appropriate Dyestuffs. Please check my price list for the information.
scripts.translation:
[染色师 吉内丁·雷菲尔]
给衣服染色需要相应的染料，详情请查看我的价目表。

scripts.text:
[Dyer Ginedin Rephere]
I'm sorry, but you don't have enough money.
scripts.translation:
[染色师 吉内丁·雷菲尔]
抱歉，你的钱不够。

scripts.text: Wow, I've never seen clothes like that before! I'm sorry, but I don't think I can paint it.
scripts.translation:
哇，我从没见过这样的衣服！
抱歉，恐怕没办法给它染色。

scripts.text:
[Dyer Ginedin Rephere]
Each color costs 10000z and 1 dye:
 
 - ^FF4422Red^000000: Scarlet Dyestuffs
 - ^D5A500Yellow^000000: Lemon Dyestuffs
 - ^AA00AAViolet^000000: Violet Dyestuffs
 - ^FF8800Orange^000000: Orange Dyestuffs
 - ^4422FFBlue^000000: CobaltBlue Dyestuffs
 - ^009500Green^000000: DarkGreen Dyestuffs
 - Black: Black Dyestuffs
scripts.translation:
[染色师 吉内丁·雷菲尔]
每种颜色收费10000 Zeny和1份染料：
 
 - ^FF4422红色^000000：红色染料
 - ^D5A500黄色^000000：黄色染料
 - ^AA00AA紫色^000000：紫色染料
 - ^FF8800橙色^000000：橙色染料
 - ^4422FF蓝色^000000：钴蓝染料
 - ^009500绿色^000000：深绿染料
 - 黑色：黑色染料

scripts.text:
[Dyer Ginedin Rephere]
Make yourself at home. Even though I don't have time for you.
scripts.translation:
[染色师 吉内丁·雷菲尔]
请自便。虽然我没时间陪你。
